title: Platinum Reserve Account: Enterprise Business Savings Overview
summary: This document describes the Platinum Reserve Account for enterprise business savings, offering a 5.0% APY with daily compounding aligned to the ledger balance. It requires a $100,000 minimum to open and maintain and includes same-day transfer capabilities and a liquidity dashboard.
